en: A black‑and‑white vintage street view showing a cobblestoned road lined with telegraph or power poles and early street lighting. On the left are stone and masonry buildings; on the right, behind trees and a low wall, is an older church-like building. Several pedestrians and a horse-drawn vehicle appear on the street. The caption at the top reads "Kuopio. Kauppakatu.", indicating this is a view of Kauppakatu street in Kuopio.
